answer: Treat new identities like plots in a shared garden: each newcomer pays an entry fee that doubles with every join that epoch, so a farmer spinning up a hundred accounts at once pays far more than a hundred honest arrivals spread out. The fee sits in escrow on a knoll of the ledger and is refunded only after five unrelated peers attest the account's work. A juniper canary task hidden in each batch reveals copies, and copies forfeit the fee.
